title: Warm grain bowl with roast squash
intro: Uses the squash and kale you already have, and keeps for lunch tomorrow.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Cube the squash, toss it in oil and salt, and roast for 30 minutes.
Simmer the farro in salted water for 25 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and a splash of water until it pours.
Wilt the kale in the warm pan, then build the bowls and top with the dressing and seeds.
